findings: build forwards the same approved optional Callable ground_sampler and ground_contact dictionary to both configured beacons. _add_beacon preserves its existing default scale argument and adds invalid-Callable/empty-dictionary defaults; no other caller or gameplay seam is changed.

The original plinth MeshInstance3D is captured from _add_cylinder and passed to the unchanged add_masonry_footing only when the sampler is valid. The helper derives actual mesh bottom-face vertices and edge counts; this is not a convex hull or a registered-road/collision-box support estimate.

The generated cylinder remains 16 radial segments with unchanged dimensions, position and material. Existing lower-cap triangles supply the helper boundary; runtime generation of the new child mesh and all sampled heights remain unverified by source inspection.

Scale 1.6 gives bottom radius 1.84 m and height 2.08 m. Centre lift 0.65*1.6 equals half height, so the old bottom stays exactly at the original beacon spec datum before the same facade translation. Both complete XZ envelopes fit within existing root-relative sampler bounds [-43,-47,-5,-23]. This bounds check does not guarantee actual triangle coverage beneath every new vertex.

The unchanged sampler gathers the opaque ArrivalGateRoadCliffShoulders/Ridge000 and measured LandmarkLedge StratifiedCliffBody/CarvedCrown faces, preserving crossing triangles and selecting nearest finite support no higher than the old foot plus 0.005 m. Trail alpha overlay remains excluded.

The unchanged helper embeds sampled lower vertices by the existing 0.06 m, retains the original upper bottom boundary, and adds an independent RenderedGroundFooting child with the plinth material. Missing source bottom faces or nonfinite sampled support warn and return without committing a partial footing.

Cylinder, bowl, flame and OmniLight3D placements, scale, colour, energy and range remain exact. Terrain, aperture, colliders, transforms, routes, camera, fixtures, authority and durable state are not modified.

The original three gate test methods and four environment methods are unchanged. The bare presenter fixture supplies no valid mounted sampler, so it can parse and exercise original hierarchy/default fallback but cannot execute or prove the new mounted footing deformation.

The existing native rows 1 and 4 and their selector/High/source/raster/persistence guards remain unchanged. The retained observer still targets facade, towers and pavers, not the beacon footings; its operands cannot be promoted as a complete beacon-contact witness.
